summary: Swedish Export Credit Corp filed a Form 6-K containing its unaudited interim financial statements and management report for the period ended June 30, 2026. The filing discloses quarterly results and IFRS financial data but does not announce any M&A transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change. This is a routine periodic reporting filing with no special-situation catalyst. The foreign private issuer is merely complying with its SEC reporting obligations under the 1934 Act. Therefore, the filing does not constitute a special situation.
